name: Reddio RedSonic Vault stETH double count via permissionless registerErc20
summary: The RedSonic Vault diamond prices its rsvETH share class from provider legs that read the vault's raw stETH balance, yet anyone could register stETH as a separate share class backed by that same balance. The attacker registered stETH, bought most rsvETH with flash-loaned ETH, deposited stETH to inflate rsvETH's backing, then redeemed rsvETH and withdrew its stETH.
notes: The facet route for registerErc20, depositErc20 and depositEth (manualWithdraw was re-added one block earlier) is the latest cut before the exploit; manualWithdraw had been removed from Sept 2024 until then, so no earlier window existed.
InvestmentManagerFacet and its LidoProvider strategy leg (configured Oct 2024) supply the raw-balance pricing half of the double count; both were live before the facet cut.
Campaign: three copycats repeated the stETH deposit and rsvETH redemption within 25 blocks; the attacker's ETH and stETH round trips are not victim loss.
